description: Foundation, 10-band. Reframe this repo from `ai-tutor` (a static study-notebook library) into **Praxis** — a constructor for interactive, gated notebook tutorials on any subject — and stand up a Tauri desktop/web shell AROUND the existing reusable core without discarding it. The core to preserve and build on: docs/notebook-rubric.md (the definition of a complete tutorial), scaffold_notebooks.py + curriculum.py (the scaffolder), nbstatus.py + tests/test_notebooks.py (the completion gate), launcher/ (the FastAPI browse/launch/render UI), and notebooks/ (221 seed notebooks). This tasklist only establishes the app skeleton + rebrand; the subject-definition, AI-construction, gating, and storage capabilities come in later bands (20/30/40/50). Note: the GitHub repo rename (ai-tutor -> praxis) and the local directory rename are MANUAL steps for the owner; this tasklist does the in-repo rebrand only. Anti-fabrication: the app must actually build and launch — a story passes only when the relevant gate (cargo build / npm run build / pytest) is green, never on a scaffold that doesn't compile.
warmup: head -20 pyproject.toml; python3 nbstatus.py --help 2>/dev/null || head -20 nbstatus.py
command -v cargo npm tauri 2>/dev/null; ls src-tauri ui 2>/dev/null || echo 'no app scaffold yet'

userStories.title: In-repo rebrand from ai-tutor to Praxis, preserving the reusable core
acceptanceCriteria: README.md is reframed from a 'study-notebook library' to Praxis — a constructor for interactive, gated notebook tutorials on any subject — with a short vision statement and an explicit map of the reusable core (rubric, scaffolder, gate, launcher, seed notebooks) it builds on.
pyproject.toml name/description and any `ai-tutor`/`ai_tutor` package or code identifiers are updated to praxis; imports still resolve.
The reusable core is PRESERVED, not deleted: docs/notebook-rubric.md, scaffold_notebooks.py, curriculum.py, nbstatus.py, tests/, launcher/, and notebooks/ all remain and still work.
A note records that the GitHub-repo and local-directory renames are manual owner steps outside this tasklist.
Gate green: `python3 -m pytest -q tests/` still passes (the notebook core is intact).

userStories.title: Tauri desktop/web shell scaffolded and building
acceptanceCriteria: A Tauri app exists: Rust backend under src-tauri/ (Cargo.toml + a minimal main) and a TS/React frontend under ui/ (package.json + a minimal app).
`cd src-tauri && cargo build` succeeds and `cd ui && npm ci && npm run build` succeeds.
The app launches to a window/dev-server showing a Praxis landing screen (no real features yet).
Gate green: cargo build + npm run build both pass (verify.sh path-scoped checks).

userStories.title: The existing notebook library browses inside the shell
acceptanceCriteria: The app browses the existing notebooks/ library — reusing the launcher's browse/launch/render (run the FastAPI launcher as a Tauri sidecar, or port its endpoints), not a reimplementation.
Each topic shows its status badge from nbstatus.py (🔴 scaffold · 🟡 partial · ✅ complete), and opening a topic renders/launches its notebook.
The 221 seed notebooks across the 10 domains are visible and openable in-app.
Gate green: cargo build + npm run build pass, and a smoke check confirms the library loads (document the check in the progress log).
